tango.inspection: Decoded all 54 final candidate frames and inspected them in chronological contact-sheet form after one revision. PASS: the backward/deep asymmetrical load visibly stores force; support breaks once; root spacing is strongly nonuniform (steep rise -> 2/1/1-row ascent taper -> immediate first downward sample -> expanding descent); the apex task cut changes limbs while facing stays right and does not create a second impulse; landing contact precedes deeper compression; feet remain fixed through rebound/overshoot/recovery; secondary task-arm lag survives after root rebound; recovery retains forward debt instead of resetting to idle.

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Right-facing offset ready; pelvis slightly behind chest; both feet stable.
timing.name: READY_SKEW

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis drops and shifts back-left before launch; torso stays pitched toward travel.
timing.name: BACK_COIL

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Deepest preload: root at lowest/backmost point; rear/left support bears the launch debt while lead side unloads.
timing.name: DEEP_ASYM_LOAD

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Support breaks after the deepest preload; root snaps up-right and never regains support before landing.
timing.name: LAUNCH_BREAK

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Large early ascent spacing; root travels steeply up-right while trailing limbs lag the impulse.
timing.name: RISE_DRIVE

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Root still rises fast but less than the prior interval; arms and legs counter-rotate to arrest launch stretch.
timing.name: RISE_COUNTERSWING

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Upward root spacing contracts sharply while horizontal travel continues; no root stop.
timing.name: APEX_APPROACH

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Final upward sample is tiny; a rightward aerial task cut reorganizes limbs while facing remains right.
timing.name: APEX_TASK_CUT

timing.motion_arc_root_note: First downward root sample immediately follows the apex; task arm remains extended while the body begins to fall.
timing.name: APEX_TURN

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Downward spacing grows; distal task arm starts late recoil while root continues right/down.
timing.name: DESCENT_RELEASE

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Descent accelerates; knees tuck asymmetrically and upper limbs close later than root motion.
timing.name: FALL_TUCK

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Feet open toward the ground while root continues descending; no support marker before contact.
timing.name: LANDING_AIM

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet acquire ground at one authored event; root is still descending and has not yet reached compression depth.
timing.name: CONTACT

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Feet stay fixed while pelvis continues down and slightly forward; torso folds late and arms still trail the fall.
timing.name: DEEP_COMPRESSION

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Fixed feet return stored compression upward; root rebounds before the task-side arm catches up.
timing.name: REBOUND

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Root nearly settles while the right arm and shoulder continue past the rebound; feet remain fixed.
timing.name: UPPER_OVERSHOOT

timing.motion_arc_root_note: Stable support returns, but pelvis/chest remain slightly forward and the rear side is already loading the next step; not an idle reset.
timing.name: RECOVERY_DEBT
